verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say it can be deployed within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose, and that Docker is the recommended self-hosting route. The CLI also runs the full Supabase service stack locally, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI works without an account. Missing for 10: documentation of feature parity between self-hosted and hosted services, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a production self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy Supabase within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose.
The fastest and recommended way to self-host Supabase is to use Docker.
